title: Add DiddyDiffusion to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [DiddyDiffusion](https://raw.githack.com/umm-dev/DiddyDiffusion/main/index.html) to image
- DiddyDiffusion is a tiny browser-based image playground powered by Pollinations. Visitors connect their own Pollinations account through BYOP, authorize a small short-lived budget, and generate images

Fixes #13513

gist.headline: Tiny diffusion, big canvas
gist.blurb: DiddyDiffusion joined the garden: a tiny browser image playground powered by Pollinations. Bring your own Pollinations account, set a small temporary budget, and make pixels happen.
gist.summary: Added DiddyDiffusion, a lightweight browser-based image playground where visitors connect their own Pollinations account through BYOP, authorize a short-lived budget, and generate images.
gist.impact: Users can now try Pollinations image generation in DiddyDiffusion with account-connected, temporary-budget access directly from the browser.
gist.visual_concept: Depict DiddyDiffusion as a tiny cozy browser playground: a retro CRT browser window turns a simple prompt into small framed pixel landscapes while Polli, wearing a painter's beret, carefully carries a little temporary Pollen budget jar. Include a few code-plants and flowers around the computer to show that a small web app can grow images from a connected Pollinations account.
